1.e4 c5 2.Nc3 e6 3.Nge2 a6 4.g3.strategy: Chooses the closed route: the pawn frees the king's bishop, which was blocked by the knight on e2, for the fianchetto on g2. White still keeps d4 in hand to open the game later with a knight recapture, which is the point of the flexible set-up.
1.e4 c5 2.Nc3 e6 3.Nge2 a6 4.g3.name: Sicilian Defence: Closed
